description: The bar chart, titled "Average Performance," displays the average performance of five different methods: Standard, Self-RAG, FactTune, ClinGS (w/), and ClinGS. The horizontal axis lists these five methods as categorical labels, while the vertical axis represents the average performance, scaled from 0 to 60 in increments of 10. Each method is represented by a single bar, with the following approximate performance values: Standard at 53, Self-RAG at 54, FactTune at 52, ClinGS (w/) at 54, and ClinGS at 59. The bars are colored differently for visual distinction: Standard is gold, Self-RAG is olive, FactTune is light green, ClinGS (w/) is light blue, and ClinGS is dark blue. The chart indicates that ClinGS achieves the highest average performance, while FactTune has the lowest among the five methods.
